summary: Connect organizational priorities, decision rights and change actions. Explore the five-day course and build a practical leadership roadmap.
lede: Aligning an organization’s priorities with its decisions, roles and day-to-day work is the focus of organizational leadership. This foundation-level course is for emerging and experienced leaders, functional managers and project leads who coordinate work across functions. It develops skills in diagnosing alignment with McKinsey 7S, clarifying decision rights with RACI, and planning change through Kotter’s 8-Step Process, with practical outputs including an alignment diagnosis, accountability chart and leadership roadmap.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course is designed for professionals who shape priorities, coordinate work across functions or lead organizational change without relying on specialist consultancy tools. It suits people who need a repeatable way to connect strategy, accountability and execution.
prerequisites: Bring familiarity with a team, function or organizational initiative you support. No coding or programming is required; no specialist software is needed for the course exercises.
